subject: prd/contract-gate
statement: The gate shall run headless and deterministically from a clean checkout with no agent, session, or network dependency, producing its verdict and (on failure) its defect report as its sole outputs.
rationale: the same artifact runs at planning entry and as the CI context; determinism is what makes a gate trustworthy
fit_criterion: the same contract inputs yield byte-identical verdicts across repeated runs (modulo declared timing fields); a network attempt by the gate fails the determinism suite; the CI-context and planning-entry invocations on one contract produce the same verdict
